questions.question_text: What is online privacy, as defined in the chapter?

options.text: The ability to use social media without any restrictions
The control over who has access to your personal information on the internet
Ensuring no one can see your online activity, even companies
Only sharing information with trusted friends onlineCorrect Answer: B) The control over who has access to your personal information on the internet

questions.question_text: What is a key characteristic of a strong password according to the chapter?

options.text: It should be short and easy to type, like your name
It should be at least 12-16 characters with a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols
It should be the same for all your accounts to avoid forgetting
It should include your favorite sports team for memorabilityCorrect Answer: B) It should be at least 12-16 characters with a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a sign ofcatfishing, as described in the chapter?

options.text: Someone sends you a funny meme on social media
Someone refuses to video chat and their photos look too perfect or inconsistent
Someone comments positively on all your posts
Someone asks to follow you on a public platformCorrect Answer: B) Someone refuses to video chat and their photos look too perfect or inconsistent

questions.question_text: What is one recommended step for safe social media use from the chapter?

options.text: Share your location in every post to connect with friends nearby
Set your profile to private so only approved followers can see your content
Post everything publicly to gain more followers quickly
Accept all friend requests to build a larger networkCorrect Answer: B) Set your profile to private so only approved followers can see your content

questions.question_text: Why is managing your digital footprint important for high schoolers?

options.text: It ensures you’ll never make mistakes online
It helps create a positive online presence for college and job applications
It prevents anyone from searching your name online
It only matters if you plan to work in technology fieldsCorrect Answer: B) It helps create a positive online presence for college and job applications

questions.question_text: What should you do if you suspect a message is a scam, based on the chapter’s advice?

options.text: Click the link to see what it’s about before deciding
Reply to ask for more details to confirm it’s real
Delete the message, report it as spam, and avoid clicking any links
Share it with friends to warn them by forwarding itCorrect Answer: C) Delete the message, report it as spam, and avoid clicking any links
